removalCriteria: Levels run A1, A2, B1, B2; from B2 pupils follow the national Portuguese curriculum
Moving up a level needs a pass in an intermediate test written by the school itself
It can happen at the end of the school year or at any other moment in the year
In years 9 and 12 the final subject classification decides, not the exam alone
A pass does not force a move: a pupil may stay two years at A1, at A2 or at B1
